# One CONNECT is one upstream TCP. PlayTranscript covers CONNECT + first GET.
# The second GET is executed in connect_test.go TestCONNECTTwoGETs (leftover
# response headers make a second S: status-line match unreliable here).
C: CONNECT {{HOST}} HTTP/1.1
C: Host: {{HOST}}
C:
S: HTTP/1.1 200 Connection Established
S:
C: GET /a HTTP/1.1
C: Host: {{HOST}}
C:
S: HTTP/1.1 200 *
